title: Chapter 11 First-Day Pre-Petition Wage Motion
description: Structured outline for Ch. 11 first-day employee wage & benefit continuity motions.
executive_summary_intent: Establish statutory priority, payroll liabilities, and operational necessity for paying pre-petition employee wages and withholding obligations.

sections.section_title: I. Payroll Obligations & Statutory Wage Cap
sections.stated_intention: Quantify unpaid pre-petition wages per employee against 11 U.S.C. § 507(a)(4) caps.
sections.routing_rationale: Requires statutory priority thresholds and payroll register totals.
required_fact_queries: Total pre-petition accrued employee wages and pay period dates
Maximum unpaid wage amount owed to any individual employee

sections.section_title: II. Trust-Fund Taxes, Benefits & Lien Priorities
sections.stated_intention: Verify payroll taxes, benefit withholdings, and secured lender cash-collateral position.
sections.routing_rationale: Checks trust-fund exclusions and secured lender consent or carve-outs.
required_fact_queries: Unremitted payroll tax withholdings and benefit premiums
Secured loan / cash collateral restrictions on operational disbursements

sections.section_title: III. Cash Liquidity & Doctrine of Necessity
sections.stated_intention: Demonstrate post-petition liquidity coverage and going-concern harm if unpaid.
sections.routing_rationale: Synthesizes debtor cash runway and workforce retention risks.
required_fact_queries: Current operating cash balance and 13-week cash forecast
Operational dependencies and workforce attrition risk disclosures
